verdict.rationale: Synctera documents a first-party Webhook API that lets integrators subscribe to specific platform events, with Synctera pushing updates to the integrator. That is registrable outbound HTTP callbacks a programmatic consumer can receive. The evidence is only two short doc snippets. Missing for 10: details on event catalog, signature verification, retry/delivery semantics, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks

citations.quote: The Webhook API enables integrators to subscribe to specific events on the Synctera platform.
With webhooks, Synctera will push updates to the integrator instead of the integrator pulling updates.
